payload.claim: DESIGN.md §4.2.1 states exit `2` covers exactly three cases: `INFRASTRUCTURE`, `INCOMPLETE`, and 'a preflight failure that takes the whole batch'. The new budget-admission refusal in `saffron/cli.py` (the `return 2` at the `args.budget < total` check) also exits `2`, but it runs after readiness has already passed (`readiness.ok` is true) and is not a preflight check at all — it is a new, distinct refusal reason the diff does not add to this documented enumeration. Since specs and operators cite `DESIGN.md` by section number as the authoritative exit-code contract, this leaves a fourth, undocumented exit-`2` case.
